title: Power Apps: build model-driven apps with Copilot Cowork
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned model-driven app skill from documented Cowork controls and the existing coding-tools skill. The licensing correction and all six control surfaces are supported; the spending-policy endpoint flagged by the pre-check is documented.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Cowork requires an active Microsoft 365 Copilot licence assigned to the user.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot access: An active Microsoft 365 Copilot license assigned to your account.

claims.claim: Admins must enable usage-based billing before users can access Cowork.
claims.quote: To allow users to access Cowork, admins must enable usage-based billing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Cowork uses usage-based billing measured in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Use spending policies in the Cost Management dashboard to control access and Copilot Credit spending for AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing.

claims.claim: Cowork consumption includes model responses, tool and skill calls, image generation and browser tasks.
claims.quote: Activities such as model responses, tool and skill calls, image generation, and browser tasks count toward your organization's consumption.

claims.claim: Users of Cowork plugins must have Microsoft 365 Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses: Users who use Cowork plugins must have Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses assigned.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A spending policy that selects Cowork grants Cowork access to users within its scope.
claims.quote: Any user in the scope of a spending policy that selects Cowork can use Cowork, regardless of how small the credit limit is.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: A low spending-policy credit limit does not block Cowork access.
claims.quote: A policy with a limit of one credit still grants access. To remove access for a user, remove them from every spending policy that includes Cowork. A low credit limit doesn't block access.

claims.claim: A spending policy selecting Cowork can be scoped to a security group.
claims.quote:
On the Scope user and group step, choose Specific groups and select the security group.
On the Select agents and services step, select Cowork.

claims.claim: Credit-limit enforcement is asynchronous, so a user can sometimes start tasks after reaching a limit.
claims.quote: Credit consumption and limit enforcement are evaluated asynchronously, so a user might be able to start one or more tasks after their limit is reached before enforcement takes effect.

claims.claim: Configuration on the Cowork entry under Agents > All Agents has no effect on who can use Cowork.
claims.quote: The Cowork agent entry is still visible under Agents > All Agents, but any configuration on it has no effect on who can use Cowork.

claims.claim: Removing a user from every spending policy selecting Cowork removes their Cowork access.
claims.quote: To remove access for a user, remove them from every spending policy that includes Cowork.

claims.claim: A tenant administrator can manage Cowork plugins.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 admin center access: You must be a tenant administrator, or have the Copilot administrator role.

claims.claim: The Copilot administrator role is an alternative role for managing Cowork plugins.
claims.quote: You must be a tenant administrator, or have the Copilot administrator role.

claims.claim: Dataverse database capacity covers table rows, metadata and relational data created by custom model-driven apps.
claims.quote: Tracks structured data stored directly in Dataverse, including table rows, metadata, and relational data created by Power Apps, Power Automate, Dynamics 365 customer engagement apps (Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Service, Dynamics 365 Marketing), and custom model-driven apps.

claims.claim: The capacity report does not count trial, preview, support and developer environments for consumption.
claims.quote: The capacity report counts default, production, and sandbox environments for consumption. It doesn't count trial, preview, support, and developer environments.
